title: Water-quality reports
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify any failed tests.
3. Create one row for examination row to accurately report test results for composite and individual water samples for any failed test as described in the ERS Vera c™ user manual.

## Example 1. Single examination for a single failed test for a composite sample (no option for designating compliant or non-compliant result)

- 1.1 Start with the failed test and look for the Filtration Identification code if specified in the record.
- 1.2 If a composite sampling method is specified or no sampling method is specified, then create one row in examination row with its value equal to the sample container identification number.

**Note:** If more than one identification number has been given in the failed test record associated with the composite sample, then using only one of the given sample identification numbers is sufficient.

Proceed with examination row variable construction in the ERS Vera c™ user manual for Exams chapter
